# TechEdge Accounting

> London accountants for technology companies, SaaS founders, Amazon and Shopify sellers, startups and UK SMEs. Fixed monthly fees, Xero-based bookkeeping, and a qualified ACCA accountant (Mubarik Mohamed) on every account.

## Who we help
- Technology companies and SaaS founders: bookkeeping, management accounts, R&D-aware year-end, corporation tax
- Amazon FBA and Shopify sellers: settlement reconciliation (A2X / Link My Books into Xero), UK VAT, EU OSS, Amazon fee VAT
- Startups and limited companies: incorporation, payroll, VAT registration, year-end accounts, CT600
- Sole traders and landlords: Self Assessment, Making Tax Digital for Income Tax quarterly updates
- Property SPV limited companies

## Pricing (fixed fees, agreed upfront)
- Sole Trader: from £75/month
- Essentials: from £150/month
- Growth: from £350/month
- Scale: from £650/month
- Self Assessment tax return: £99
- One-off work (CT600, VAT registration, penalty appeals): fixed quote within 24 hours

- Based in London, working with clients across the UK
